content.title: March Madness games on TV today: Full schedule, times, channels, scores for Sunday NCAA Elite Eight
content.text: March Madness games on TV today: Full schedule, times, channels, scores for Sunday NCAA Elite Eight originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.Two Final Four slots filled, two to go.AdvertisementThe 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight concludes Sunday with a pair of No. 1 seeds in action as Michigan meets No. 6 seed Tennessee and Duke faces No. 2 UConn in perhaps the most anticipated game of the bracket so far.The Wolverines are just two years removed but also worlds away from an 8-24 campaign as they eye their first trip to the national semifinals since falling to Villanova in the 2018 title game. The Volunteers, on the other hand, have never reached the Final Four, falling at this stage the last two years.The final matchup of the weekend is about as good as it gets, with the Blue Devils trying to book a return trip to the Final Four and the Huskies' hopes of a third national championship in four seasons still alive.Who will join Arizona and Illinois in Indianapolis next week? Here's everything you need to know about when and where to tune in and watch all of Sunday's action.AdvertisementElite EightSunday, March 29GameTime (ET)TV/Live streamNo. 1 Michigan 95, No. 6 Tennessee 62——No. 1 Duke vs. No. 2 UConn5:05 p.m.CBS, Fubo, Paramount+Where to watch March Madness games todayTV channel: CBSBoth of Sunday's Elite Eight games will air on CBS.
